Subject (in full) Seizure and subsequent release of Japanese goods

Made by J.D.S. Umemoto Forwarded by (签名)

At 6 a.m. August 11, 1931, 7,500 gunny bags, valued at
$2,500.00 , the property of the Eiwa Yoko, Japanese firm, No.9
Canton Road, were seized by pickets of the anti-Japanese
Association on the Soochow Creek near Tungking Road, whilst being
transported in a lighter from the Toa Jute Factory to the S.S.
"Seikyo Maru" berthed at the O.S.K. wharf for shipment to Keelung.
The lighter was detained alongside a river police boat lying
on the Chinese side of the Soochow Creek near Tungking Road.

The Japanese Authorities immediately lodged a protest with
the Chinese Authorities who issued an order instructing that the
seized goods were to be released at once. However, when the
representatives of the Japanese and Chinese Authorities and the
owner of the goods proceeded to the scene to effect the release
under the strength of this order, they were flatly refused.

Later, having been requested by the owner, the Commander
of the Japanese Landing Force despatched 10 marines under an
officer. They passed through the Settlement and arrived on the
opposite side of Tungking Road in the Settlement at about 12.30
p.m. August 11, 1931. The officer disarmed himself and alone
went by a sampan to the lighter which was being detained, where-
upon the pickets on seeing him approach dispersed. The owner
was then able to tow away the lighter to its destination.

M. Umemoto
J. D. S.

A summary of the above appeared in the
Intelligence Report of August 12.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

1931年8月13日下午

事由（全称） 扣押及随后释放日本货物

呈报人 J.D.S. Umemoto 转呈人 （签名）

1931年8月11日上午6时，属于广东路9号日本商号“荣和洋行”（Eiwa Yoko）的7,500只麻袋（价值2,500.00美元），在由驳船从东亚黄麻厂运往停泊于大阪商船会社码头的“清教丸”号（S.S. "Seikyo Maru"）以装运至基隆途中，于苏州河靠近天津路处被抗日协会纠察队扣押。该驳船被扣留在苏州河中国一侧、靠近天津路的一艘水上警察艇旁。

日本当局随即向中国当局提出抗议，中国当局遂发布命令，指示立即释放被扣货物。然而，当日本和中国当局的代表以及货主依据此命令前往现场执行释放时，却遭到断然拒绝。

此后，应货主请求，日本海军陆战队指挥官派遣一名军官率领10名海军陆战队员前往。他们穿过租界，于1931年8月11日中午12时30分左右抵达租界内天津路对岸。该军官解除武装，独自乘舢板前往被扣留的驳船，纠察队见其接近便四散离去。货主随后得以将驳船拖往目的地。

M. Umemoto
J. D. S.

上述内容的摘要已刊登于8月12日的《情报报告》中。
特别科科长。
